name: Native N, resolution-corrected galaxy anchors
result: NR2 replaces NR1 mixed-resolution galaxy anchors with ng80 at all three measured masses: SPARC median stellar M/L is about 0.75/0.76; 24/40 joint seed draws pass its normalization cut, 16 fail high. The galaxy mass trend remains adverse and three inherited cluster keys are overpredicted.
obstruction: Normalization is not a joint normalization, trend, dwarf, cluster and abundance pass.
scope: Nine seeds at each of three masses, isolated collisionless formation profiles. Other dwarf, lensing and local-mass holdouts were not all rerun on these anchors; cluster anchors remain ng64. Does not prove the profile is the stable outcome of the microscopic PN28 action.
nonrepeat: Do not reuse NR1 as a fully converged all-anchor pass or rerun the same ng80 normalization as a new mechanism.
next_new_step: A materially different same-parent formation or baryon-response prediction must confront all observables jointly.

name: No artificial halo floor
result: On the native profile, removing the floor does not destroy the reported SPARC-only normalization result; floor-inactive cluster comparisons are unchanged.
obstruction: This removes a discretionary switch but does not explain dwarf structure, mass trends or cluster residuals.
scope: No-floor extension of the same empirical/native-profile pipeline. Footings that become identical are not independent successes.
nonrepeat: Do not add back a mass floor merely to repeat a preferred galaxy fit.
next_new_step: Any physical cutoff must be independently selected and tested against dwarf and lensing evidence.

name: Cold-share mass accounting
result: FC1 corrects total-matter zoom masses to cold share, f_c about 0.8405. Its later A4 measured-gas ng64 cluster rerun fails both footings, superseding earlier headline partial passes.
obstruction: A bookkeeping correction is required but does not supply missing cluster radial structure.
scope: Accounting correction transfers where dust zoom mass included total matter; earlier fitted grades do not transfer to another profile or gas convention.
nonrepeat: Do not count the baryons twice or quote the pre-A4 cluster pass.
next_new_step: Retain the corrected source ledger in any new architecture; derive additional radial structure separately.

name: Full adiabatic response on converged anchors
result: Applying UR1 to NR2 gives stellar M/L about 0.35/0.36 and tilt about +0.17; LT residual about +0.116. Cluster 14-key recovery still leaves X-COP shape residuals.
obstruction: The response lowers galaxy M/L too far while not jointly fixing group/cluster shape.
scope: Specific adiabatic shell response, measured native anchors and adopted stellar/gas inputs; not a no-go for all kinetic histories.
nonrepeat: Do not repeat full UR1 on the same converged profile as an unexplored rescue.
next_new_step: Change a physical response premise, not its fitted output, and regrade the simultaneous gates.

name: Low-mass profile requirement map
result: Frozen NR4 verdict is NOT DECIDED because original grid checks missed their 1e-6 tolerance; later finer-grid agreement repairs a numerical comparison but does not rewrite the frozen result. Descriptively, only 1/36 cells succeeds and lies outside measured seeds.
obstruction: The apparent remaining corner is neither an independently selected profile nor a certified frozen pass.
scope: Finite low-mass multiplier and response grid. At measured response about 0.87 the inspected m>=1 cells do not recover M/L 0.5; this is not an all-parameter theorem.
nonrepeat: Do not silently promote a repaired comparison or outside-seed fit to the frozen primary verdict.
next_new_step: Only a new physical low-mass formation prediction would warrant a new independently frozen grade.

name: Live smooth-disc contraction
result: Nine paired 1e12 collisionless runs show substantial live contraction: median reported R_live about 2.154 and response strength f_Q about 0.872, with seed variation.
obstruction: The measured response is much stronger than the suppression required in the troubled spiral range.
scope: Gravity-only isolated halo plus smooth growing disc; this is an actual collisionless response control, not a native PN28 kinetic formation proof or a live bar calculation.
nonrepeat: Do not assume weak response to a smooth baryonic monopole after LC1.
next_new_step: A new mechanism must change the dynamics and measure retained radial mass after the same baryonic growth.

name: Disc assembled during collapse
result: Frozen PZ1 asks whether co-assembly differs from post-formation contraction. Controls and turnaround records exist; the snapshot has no completed graded paired-sample outcome. Seed 6 has a turnaround record, later than the amendment describing its search.
obstruction: No final response ratio or galaxy verdict can be inferred from initial conditions, control passes or turnaround completion.
scope: Nine-seed collapse comparison with recorded turnaround amendment; status means incomplete evidence, not an assertion that a process is presently running.
nonrepeat: Do not launch a duplicate co-assembly experiment or call this a failed/positive result while its owned lane is unfinished.
next_new_step: Reconcile the existing owner lane when completed; preserve its frozen criteria and amendment.

name: Constant response-strength and mass-shift map
result: The 180-cell flat/inner response-strength and mass-shift map has no jointly acceptable cell in the reported NR1/NR2 comparisons.
obstruction: One shared strength and a permissible halo mass shift do not reconcile galaxy normalization, trend and other gates.
scope: Finite specified response interpolation grammar; not a theorem against all spatial or history-dependent responses.
nonrepeat: Do not repeat a constant strength sweep or small normalization displacement.
next_new_step: Any continuation needs a derived change in the dependence on state, radius or history.

name: Mass-falling response requirement
result: Six of 75 fitted cells pass the five specified gates, all with high-mass response f_hi=0 or 0.2 and transition log10 baryon mass 9.5 or 10. No f_hi>=0.4 cell passes. Clusters remain 12/15 keys with adverse X-COP residuals.
obstruction: The surviving cells prescribe selective weak spiral response; they do not derive a selector or satisfy cluster radial constraints.

nonrepeat: Do not present another mass-only interpolation fit as the missing dynamics.
next_new_step: Test a separately derived state/history selector against the same required ordering and cluster shape without fitting response strength.

name: One shell rule, opposite galaxy/cluster signs
result: The same shell prescription contracts baryon-dominated galaxy interiors and can expand cluster interiors where local baryon fraction is below the cosmic reference.
obstruction: Correct sign differentiation does not establish the necessary amplitudes or measured-gas outer profile.
scope: Adiabatic shell prescription and its mass ledger; cluster response must not be described generically as contraction.
nonrepeat: Do not introduce a galaxy/cluster label switch or discard the rule solely by confusing its signs.
next_new_step: A same-action dynamical derivation must reproduce the sign and independently supply the correct magnitude.

name: Halo mass versus response pinch
result: In the tested full-response architecture galaxy M/L recovery requires about -0.30 dex halo shift, while the blue-lensing interval reaches only about -0.10 dex; other gates prefer positive shifts.
obstruction: A universal halo mass renormalization moves the observables in incompatible directions.
scope: Historical profile inputs; NR3 independently confirms the normalization problem with converged anchors. Lensing bound retains isolation-systematic qualifications.
nonrepeat: Do not repeat a universal mass offset as a joint repair.
next_new_step: Change a physical radial/state dependence while retaining independent lensing normalization.

name: Energy budget to undo contraction
result: Stellar/BH energy can be plentiful, but a common coupling removes dwarf contraction before solving the spiral target: the response ordering is wrong.
obstruction: Available energy does not select the required deposition, radial redistribution or target population.
scope: ER1 profile functional is a comparator; the later bar review corrects interpreting delta W/2 as exact mechanical undo work in an extended baryon potential.
nonrepeat: Do not re-establish a raw energy surplus or reuse the comparator as exact available mechanical work.
next_new_step: Derive reciprocal coupling and retained monopole redistribution with the actual baryon potential.

name: Potential sloshing coupling
result: The chosen sloshing factor improves relative coupling but needs efficiency at least about 0.46 and leaves tilt about +0.56; the target bin reaches 0.50 only near unit efficiency.
obstruction: The finite coupling prescription does not reverse the required dwarf/spiral ordering or jointly fit galaxies.
scope: Specific potential-fluctuation proxy and shared efficiency; does not exclude all nonadiabatic forcing histories.
nonrepeat: Do not refit the same shared sloshing efficiency.
next_new_step: A new prediction must supply a different physical deposition spectrum and a conserved mass-response calculation.

name: Gas-fountain coupling
result: Three tested fountain normalizations fail; coupling grows about 4.7-fold while undo cost grows about 5-fold, leaving ordering essentially unchanged. The corrected A1 mutation supersedes an earlier misleading control.
obstruction: Adding a stellar fraction can double-count the stellar weighting already present in SN energy.
scope: Finite prescribed fountain couplings and energy comparator, not all feedback physics.
nonrepeat: Do not repeat the three normalizations or quote the pre-correction mutation.
next_new_step: Require independently measured gas cycling and a new dynamical transfer calculation rather than a second stellar weight.

name: Jeans denominator interpolation
result: M/L remains about 0.43/0.44 overall and 0.37/0.38 in the target bin, with tilt at least about +0.20; the advertised outer recovery also fails its limit check.
obstruction: An inserted pressure denominator does not derive the amplitude or preserve the claimed outer limit.

nonrepeat: Do not reuse this denominator as a derived pressure response.
next_new_step: Only an actual parent-equation response with verified limits is a new test.

name: Core enthalpy plus stellar correction
result: The stellar term adds only about 0.02 in target-bin M/L, reaching about 0.40 rather than the suggested 0.52–0.55.
obstruction: The correction is too small and remains an assumed response rule.
scope: Same phenomenological enthalpy family as JC1, not independent microscopic evidence.
nonrepeat: Do not repeat the stellar numerator correction as an untried rescue.
next_new_step: A new term needs a parent-action derivation before an observational fit.

name: Star-saturated response fit
result: A post-hoc squared saturation form reaches overall M/L about 0.47/0.46, tilt about +0.10 and LT about +0.105, still narrowly missing its cuts.
obstruction: The chosen saturation law is fitted rather than dynamically selected and its holdouts fail.

nonrepeat: Do not optimize another saturation exponent against the same targets.
next_new_step: A physical response calculation must predict a form before independent holdout grading.

name: Saturated-response independent holdouts
result: DiskMass ratio about 1.212 exceeds the 0.9–1.1 gate; Milky Way V+K-only chi-square about 79–116 exceeds 59.9. The negative halo shift that helps one line damages group LT.

nonrepeat: Do not report SR1 as a complete pass without SR2.
next_new_step: A different prediction must pass the existing holdouts without reusing them for tuning.

name: Exact thin-disc monopole
result: Geometric correction is roughly ten percent, not the factor-of-two suppression needed; tested adiabatic variants still fail the joint normalization and LT gates.
obstruction: Sphericalizing the disc differently does not account for selective weak response.

nonrepeat: Do not rerun the disc-monopole replacement as a new mechanism.
next_new_step: A genuine nonadiabatic or non-axisymmetric response must calculate its conserved dynamics.

name: Orbit-count memory proxy
result: The proposed inverse-box quantity reduces to potential and cosmic calendar rather than the claimed local orbit counter; selected thresholds depend strongly on the chosen age convention.
obstruction: The suggested invariant does not encode the claimed dynamical memory.
scope: Obstruction applies to this proxy, not to an independently evolved distribution function with real history.
nonrepeat: Do not relabel the same potential/calendar proxy as a derived number of orbits.
next_new_step: A history selector must be carried by specified evolved state variables.

name: Rotation-support gate
result: The hand-chosen velocity-dispersion gate returns nearly response-off galaxy values, M/L about 0.73/0.74, tilt about +0.54 and LT about +0.147; cluster shape is not solved.
obstruction: No parent derivation selects the gate. Its separate no-torque argument from Kelvin circulation is invalid and is corrected in ER2.
scope: Finite gate test; circulation conservation is not angular-momentum conservation for a rotating nonspherical forcing.
nonrepeat: Do not reuse this gate, and do not propagate its false no-torque theorem.
next_new_step: A derived orbital distribution and reciprocal torque calculation is a changed premise, still requiring a monopole response.

name: Outer-key projection and environmental ceiling
result: Frozen verdict remains NO VERDICT because the mutation separation is about 0.16 versus required 0.5. Descriptively the required outer mass is roughly 21–27%; optimistic environmental projections are smaller and compensated terms can have the wrong sign.

next_new_step: Reconcile existing Part-A artifacts under their frozen checks; any native dynamical comparison is a separate hypothesis.

name: Live core versus cusp, part B

result: The trough remains with and without adiabatic response; the tested predictors not using observed velocity fail to explain it, with 21/43 target fits floor-censored.
obstruction: No tested independent predictor supplies the required selective response.

obstruction: No tested response prescription jointly wins the independent local-mass tests, and inner mass alone does not uniquely identify a response mechanism.

next_new_step: A candidate must predict both radial and vertical/local constraints with the same mass ledger.

name: Same-radius measured-gas audit
result: The 45-object gas calibration offset is about +0.005 +/- 0.017 dex rather than the roughly +0.093 dex needed. The +0.111 offset in five massive X-COP systems cannot be transferred to the full sample.
obstruction: An unsupported global gas shift is not an observationally allowed cluster repair.

name: SN retention replacing the empirical mass relation
result: Energy, momentum and capped retention variants leave large galaxy tilt; response-on normalization is about 0.30. A capped variant improves LT but requires blue-lensing mass shift about +0.27 dex, outside its +0.14 bound.
obstruction: Finite energy ceilings do not determine actual efficiency; high-mass fair-share retention cannot provide the missing cluster outer material.

result: Primary cooling thresholds log M about 10.876/11.035 lie far below the demanded about 12.19 floor, and free input choices move the threshold by roughly 2.4–2.7 dex.
obstruction: Gas cooling has no derived coupling that removes the cold halo; cooling tends to contract baryons, and a per-halo condition is not a basin threshold.

obstruction: A selected threshold fit does not transfer to independent populations.
scope: Historical CL2/holdout architecture, not a current invitation to reopen the owner-closed T lane.
nonrepeat: Do not rerun its fitted threshold/concentration grid or omit failed holdouts.

name: IC1613 inclination and footing audit
result: Inclinations at or above the frozen 30-degree central falsifier disfavor the halo-free fits on both footings; photometric inclination uncertainty prevents an absolute exclusion.
obstruction: The fit relies on a restrictive inclination choice rather than a robust prediction.

name: Blue-lens halo normalization and profile shape
result: Blue-lens amplitude allows halo shift about +0.03 dex with interval [-0.10,+0.14], while red lenses favor about +0.32. The reported Route-E blue profile has chi-square about 109.2 versus about 27.5 for the law comparator.
obstruction: Amplitude consistency does not guarantee radial-shape consistency; photometric isolation leakage remains a systematic.

nonrepeat: Do not tune a global mass shift outside the blue interval or declare shape success from amplitude alone.
next_new_step: A candidate must predict color/environment selection and radial lensing shape under verified isolation.

name: Isolation-systematic nested audit
result: The frozen verdict remains NO VERDICT after the clone check fails. Later fixed-per-lens correction gives a law lead for stricter isolation, but an extreme host veto reduces the difference to about 4.3 with both fitting.
obstruction: Post-hoc corrections and isolation sensitivity prevent a decisive universal model ranking.

name: L-star analog normalization check
result: Older cf=4 L-star analog deficits were about 34.7/25.7 km/s; the later native-converged profile largely removes this deficit in the post-hoc analog comparison.
obstruction: This corrects an obsolete specific normalization objection but does not establish the full galaxy/holdout architecture.

name: Native abundance matching
result: At baryon mass 1e10 the inferred cold halo log mass is about 11.88 versus empirical-relation 11.18; halos are about 3–4 times too common or the assigned relation too light, and substituting the new relation damages SPARC.
obstruction: The profile/formation branch lacks a jointly consistent abundance and galaxy mass assignment.

name: Shared forcing-clock models
result: Twelve shared clock models give target-to-dwarf transfer ratios below about 0.08 in the original comparison; the displacement audit changes values but preserves the wrong ordering.
obstruction: Coherent epicycle energy is not irreversible retained mass redistribution, and the chosen common histories do not select the target spirals.

name: Clump infall budget and ordering
result: Three percent of baryons is insufficient for all 43 targets; three percent of halo mass can supply the comparator budget but consumes roughly 45–49 percent of baryons and lacks an observed clump inventory.
obstruction: Assumed clump content, friction ordering and missing native wake prevent a derived selective mechanism; friction is faster in dwarfs in the proxy.
scope: Budget/mean-Q/friction estimates and specified clump inventory, not a nonlinear live clump result.
nonrepeat: Do not change the denominator from baryon to halo mass and call the same clump budget observationally supplied.

name: Structural bar selector and finite reservoirs
result: An ELN proxy selects 32/43 target spirals versus 1/47 dwarfs, but also 6/10 high-mass objects. Initial bar-region angular momentum pays none of the target costs across tested geometries; whole-stellar reservoirs are only conditional.
obstruction: The structural proxy is not an evolved bar prediction; some exponential disc masses exceed total photometric light, and the energy comparator needs the later mechanical correction.
scope: Finite observational selector/budget study; current bars need not encode past history, and a new native response kernel is a separate calculation.
nonrepeat: Do not repeat the ELN/budget fits or treat their selected labels as a physically demonstrated halo response.
next_new_step: A reciprocal live history must show lasting mass redistribution with a finite observed reservoir and retain the dwarf/high-mass controls.

name: Homogeneous wave response and torque correction
result: ER2 corrects the false inference from circulation conservation to zero torque. Its homogeneous Gaussian-bar calculation gives strong suppression in the cold-wave limit; increasing sound speed changes the static pressure state as well.
obstruction: The homogeneous approximation cannot settle finite inhomogeneous orbital resonances, and nonzero linear work does not determine radial redistribution.
scope: Specified homogeneous wave response; later finite-background DR01 belongs to a separately audited row and cannot inherit observational passes here.
nonrepeat: Do not rerun the homogeneous wave or claim Kelvin forbids gravitational torque; do not call linear work a contraction cure.
next_new_step: The uncomputed implication is retained monopole response with reciprocal forcing, subject to the actual background and conservation laws.

name: Formation spin/contraction diagnostic
result: Existing nine-seed spin/contraction diagnostics do not yield a predictive rescue: adding spin worsens held-out behavior; ideal inverse rank ordering can flatten a brightness trend but leaves M/L around 0.4 below 0.5.
obstruction: Small-sample correlation and deliberately favorable rank rearrangement do not define a physical selection law.
scope: Reanalysis of existing seeds, not new dynamics or a proof against orbital-structure selection.
nonrepeat: Do not rerun rank assignments or call a fitted seed correlation a formed distribution function.
next_new_step: A genuinely new orbital-state selector must be independently evolved and predict held-out mass redistribution.

name: Frozen final-grade assembly
result: Frozen criteria, harness checks and law-only results exist; the snapshot has no completed 11-line architecture scoreboard. The law-only primary has canonical M/L about 0.52, alternative about 0.44; these are partial components, not full grades.
